ai.help_message:
🤖 **Assistant Commands**

**`/new`**
Starts a fresh conversation context.

**`/model [name]`**
Switches the active AI model.
- **List models:** Type `/model` without arguments.
- **Switch:** Type `/model gemini` or `/model mistral`.

**`/help`**
Shows this help message.

💡 **Tips:**
- **Edit:** Click the pen icon on any message to modify it.
- **Regenerate:** Click the refresh icon to get a new response.
- **Copy:** Use the copy button to grab code or text.

prefs.bar.panels.desc: Every bar on screen: its edge, style and modules. Click a panel in the preview to edit it.
prefs.presets.studio.desc: Your looks, ready to switch. Try one for a few seconds, mix the parts you like, or save what you have now.
prefs.presets.empty: No presets yet. Save your current look to create the first one.
prefs.presets.drop: Drop a preset file to import it
prefs.presets.dialog.save_current: Save the current look as a preset
prefs.presets.name.invalid: Use a name without “/”, leading dots or extra spaces.
prefs.presets.name.builtin: A built-in preset already uses this name.
prefs.presets.name.taken: You already have a preset with this name.
prefs.presets.mixer.preview_hint: Live preview on your wallpaper. Pick where each part comes from, then create the preset.
prefs.presets.aspect.layout.desc: Bar, notch, dock, overview and workspaces
prefs.presets.aspect.colors.desc: Theme, light/dark, fonts, roundness, glass and color scheme
prefs.presets.aspect.windows.desc: Gaps, borders, blur and shadows, animation speed
prefs.presets.aspect.desktop.desc: Desktop clock, icons and wallpaper transition
prefs.presets.aspect_not_set: Not part of this preset: applying it keeps your settings
prefs.presets.readonly: Built-in presets are read-only. Duplicate this one to make your own version you can change.
prefs.presets.editing: Editing preset “%1” — changes save to the preset
prefs.presets.editing.desc: The preset is applied so you see every change live. Save to store it; your previous look comes back.
prefs.sys.language.desc: Language of the whole shell. Auto follows your system locale.
prefs.sys.weather_location.desc: City name or "lat,lon". Leave empty to detect it from your IP.
prefs.sys.weather_unit.desc: Unit used by the weather widgets.
prefs.sys.prefix.desc: Type it in the launcher to jump to this mode (no spaces, up to 8 characters).
prefs.sys.rotate_cover.desc: Spin the album art like a vinyl disc while music plays.
prefs.sys.dashboard_persist.desc: Keep dashboard tabs loaded after leaving them: faster switching, more memory.
prefs.sys.dashboard_max_tabs.desc: Most dashboard tabs kept in memory at once.
prefs.sys.lock_cmd.desc: Runs when the session locks (loginctl lock-session, idle listeners).
prefs.sys.idle_listeners.desc: Commands run after a period without input, in order: dim, lock, screen off, suspend. On resume runs when you come back.
prefs.sys.idle_listeners.empty: No idle listeners: the screen never dims, locks or sleeps by itself.
prefs.sys.idle_on_resume.placeholder: Optional command when you are back
prefs.sys.before_sleep.desc: Runs right before the computer suspends, usually to lock the screen.
prefs.sys.after_sleep.desc: Runs when the computer wakes up, e.g. to turn the screens back on.
prefs.sys.disks.desc: Mount points shown in the system metrics.
prefs.sys.disks.empty: No disks: storage usage is hidden.
prefs.sys.clipboard_tmpfs.desc: Unpinned history lives in /tmp and is wiped on reboot. Pinned items always stay on disk.
prefs.voice.enabled.desc: Push-to-talk to the AI and dictation into any window, recognized on this computer.
prefs.voice.activation.desc: Hold the key while you talk, or tap once to start and once to stop.
prefs.voice.model.desc: q5 is lighter and faster, q8 slightly more accurate.
prefs.voice.language.desc: Language you speak. Auto detects it every time.
prefs.voice.use_gpu.desc: Much faster when a supported GPU is available.
prefs.voice.vad_auto_stop.desc: In toggle mode, stop listening by itself after a pause.
prefs.voice.vad_silence.desc: How long a pause ends the recording.
prefs.voice.vad_sensitivity.desc: Higher picks up quieter speech, lower ignores more background noise.
prefs.voice.server_vad.desc: Cut silence before recognition for faster, cleaner results.
prefs.voice.no_speech.desc: Stop when nothing is said for this long.
prefs.voice.idle_timeout.desc: Free the GPU memory when voice input is not used for this long.
prefs.voice.typing_method.desc: How dictated text reaches the focused window.
prefs.voice.punctuation.desc: Keep the punctuation and capitals whisper adds.
prefs.voice.trailing_space.desc: Add a space after each dictated phrase so the next one does not stick to it.
prefs.voice.ai_auto_send.desc: Send voice questions to the AI without reviewing them first.
prefs.voice.preview.desc: How long the transcript stays on screen after dictation.
prefs.updates.status.desc: Installed version and the newest release seen.
prefs.updates.service.desc: Look for new releases in the background (about once an hour) and notify you.
prefs.updates.ocr.desc: Languages the OCR tool recognizes. Each one needs its tesseract data installed.
prefs.term.command.desc: $TERMINAL is replaced by the terminal above, $COMMAND by what the shell runs. Examples: "gnome-terminal -- $COMMAND", "konsole -e $COMMAND".
prefs.term.kitty_font.desc: Written next to kitty's colors and applied live. Leave empty to keep the font from your kitty.conf.
prefs.term.opacity.desc: Kitty's background opacity before glass. From preset follows the preset's background surface.
prefs.term.glass.desc: The terminal is a glass surface: the glass amount scales this opacity, never below a readable floor.
prefs.term.glass.off: Glass is off: the opacity above is used as is.
prefs.term.glass.inherit: Terminal surface follows the master glass amount.
prefs.term.theming.desc: The palette is written to each app when the wallpaper or colors change. Switch off the ones you theme yourself.
prefs.notif.status.desc: Where notifications appear with your current preset.
prefs.notif.status.notch: Toasts grow out of the notch
prefs.notif.status.dnd: Do Not Disturb is on: only priority and critical ones show.
prefs.notif.status.live: Changes apply to the next notification.
prefs.notif.presentation.desc: Notch: toasts are born from the notch and grow with its shape. Corner: classic toasts. Auto follows the bar style of the preset (islands → notch, taskbars → corner).
prefs.notif.position.desc: Where corner toasts stack. Auto sits on the bar's side.
prefs.notif.timeout.desc: How long a toast stays when the app does not choose. Hovering keeps it.
prefs.notif.max_visible.desc: Older toasts slip into the history when more arrive.
prefs.notif.group.desc: One toast and one history card per app instead of one per notification.
prefs.notif.history.desc: Notifications kept in the dashboard after they hide.
prefs.notif.sound.desc: A short chime when a toast appears (never during Do Not Disturb).
prefs.notif.sound_file.desc: Any file pw-play or paplay can play. Empty uses the built-in tone.
prefs.notif.rules.desc: Match an app by name or desktop id (* is a wildcard). Mute keeps it in history only; priority stays until dismissed and passes Do Not Disturb; always show passes Do Not Disturb; sound off never chimes.
prefs.notif.rules.empty: No rules: every app behaves the same.
prefs.notif.dnd.desc: Hide toasts and sounds; everything still lands in the history.
prefs.notif.dnd_critical.desc: Critical notifications (low battery, alarms) still show during Do Not Disturb.
prefs.notif.schedule.desc: Turn Do Not Disturb on automatically every day in a time window.
prefs.notif.schedule_to.desc: End time; earlier than the start means the next morning.
prefs.effects.effect.desc: A signature texture on the shell's own surfaces (bar, notch, launcher, popups, settings). App windows are never touched.
prefs.effects.intensity.desc: How strong the effect is. Lowered automatically when text would become hard to read.
prefs.effects.flicker.desc: A short phosphor flicker when a surface appears (off when animations are off).
prefs.effects.grain.desc: Rice-paper texture; full on light surfaces, faint on dark ones.
prefs.effects.brush_highlights.desc: Paint selections, focus and active pills as ink brush strokes.
prefs.bar.ws_indicator.desc: Shape that marks the active workspace.
binds.action.workspace.move-window-speci: Send window to a named special workspace
binds.field.name: Name
specials.app_search: Add an app: type to search installed apps
specials.preload.desc: Start its apps hidden in this special when the session starts.
specials.apps_empty: No apps: opening it just shows the workspace. Add apps to launch them here when it opens.
specials.problem.duplicate: Another special has the same name
specials.unsupported: Special workspaces need Hyprland (this session runs %1). They are kept and come back on Hyprland.
specials.templates_hint: Hidden workspaces you toggle with a key, each with its own apps. Start from a template:
specials.dashboard.title: Special workspaces
specials.dashboard.empty: None yet: create them in Settings > Special workspaces.
launcher.provider.specials.desc: Open a special workspace by name
prefs.cat.specials.desc: Scratchpads with their own apps and keys
prefs.specials.list.desc: Each has a name, icon, accent, a toggle key, a key that sends the active window there, and apps that open in it. They are global like your keybinds: switching presets never changes them.
prefs.specials.enabled.desc: Their keys, window rules, app launching and preload. Off keeps the list but does nothing.
prefs.specials.launch_timeout.desc: How long an app may take to show its window; it is never launched twice meanwhile.
prefs.specials.preload_delay.desc: Wait after login before preloading apps.
onboarding.specials.title: Create special workspaces
onboarding.specials.subtitle: Hidden workspaces for chat, music or code that pop up on a key. Optional: skip if you don't need them.
